upheld.reason: The Statement fixes an oriented four-dimensional affine Minkowski space and the three rest-frame basis vectors e1,e2,e3. Its sum from i=1 to3 is a fixed coordinate expression for one observer, not a variable indexed family that may be empty. The supplied future timelike momentum and observer are mandatory; Proof 1.1 uses their nonzero Lorentz pairing. No empty aggregate boundary is asserted.

The Statement only asserts the moving-constraint consistency equation as a necessary condition on a stationary chart path. Its reference to thm-cm-stationarity-iff-euler-lagrange supplies the first variation equivalence used in Proof 1.1; it does not assert that the consistency equation alone implies stationary action or constraint tangency.

The Statement has no converse from the displayed consistency equation to stationarity. Proof 2.2 differentiates an already constrained solution, and 3.1 substitutes its Hamiltonian vector field. The word iff belongs to the cited Euler–Lagrange supplier, not a reverse conclusion of this result.
